sn11.4:1.3: Vepacitti (“wise thinker”) was the lord of the _asuras_ and Sakka’s counterpart; their relationship status is complicated. The Sanskrit form is _vipracitti_, but in Buddhist texts it is incorrectly Sanskritized to _vemacitra_. He seems not to appear in early Sanskrit texts, but the Mahābhārata and Purāṇas regard him as the eldest son of Danū and hence chief of the Dānavas.
sn11.4:7.3: I follow BB’s interpretation here. I’m not very happy with it, but can’t fault it.
